semantics: At ordinary central settings, the ISR trial acceptance wt is multiplied by actual mother/daughter PDF ratio, warns when wt>1 and pT^2>1GeV^2, then the loop exits because wt<uniform is false. It is not an event-weight variation. The proposal/PDF estimates can be refreshed only after long evolution or thresholds; this read-only audit does not identify the exact cause/overshoot magnitude in any trial because stock logs omit coordinates and wt.
coverage_limit: No warning is printed for wt>1 when pT^2<=1GeV^2. Warned ISR candidates may lose the ISR/FSR competition or fail branch kinematics; a warning-bearing endpoint need not be an accepted ISR winner.
modifications: No Pythia source, library, production settings or original event changes.
settings_only_control: Stock UncertaintyBands:overSampleISR increases trial headroom when variations are enabled, but the validated matching driver intentionally rejects uncertainty variations. No such control is performed, and finite headroom would not constitute a global envelope certificate.
